final: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT a.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account AS a JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.district_id, d.A3), region_averages AS (SELECT region, AVG(account_count) AS avg_count FROM district_counts GROUP BY region), step3 AS (SELECT dc.district_id, dc.region, dc.account_count, dc.account_count - ra.avg_count AS difference FROM district_counts AS dc JOIN region_averages AS ra ON dc.region = ra.region WHERE dc.account_count > ra.avg_count), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(account_count) AS avg_count FROM step3), ratios AS (SELECT s.district_id, s.region, s.account_count, s.difference, s.account_count / s4.avg_count AS ratio FROM step3 AS s CROSS JOIN step4 AS s4), top10 AS (SELECT ratio FROM ratios ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10), threshold AS (SELECT MIN(ratio) AS min_ratio FROM top10) SELECT r.district_id, r.region, r.account_count, r.difference, r.ratio FROM ratios AS r CROSS JOIN threshold AS t WHERE r.ratio >= t.min_ratio ORDER BY r.ratio DESC
